modes_and_events: Build a 60 s closed-loop fixed-wing flight model in Simulink.
Use xaero02_input.waypoints_m as the active mission, apply xaero02_input.crosswind_step_mps as a lateral wind step at 3 s, and initialize the forward airspeed from xaero02_input.initial_airspeed_mps.

interfaces.name: xaero02_input
interfaces.description: MATLAB base-workspace input declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: Read xaero02_input from the MATLAB base workspace. Use xaero02_input.waypoints_m as the active mission, apply xaero02_input.crosswind_step_mps as a lateral wind step at 3 s, and initialize the forward airspeed from xaero02_input.initial_airspeed_mps. The xaero02_input struct contains waypoints_m as a finite real 3-by-4 matrix whose columns are successive [x;y;z] waypoint positions in metres, crosswind_step_mps as a finite real scalar in [-6, 6] m/s, and initial_airspeed_mps as a finite real scalar in [12, 18] m/s.

interfaces.name: flight_state
interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: Log complete-run Timeseries named flight_state, tracking_state, and actuator_state. flight_state has width 10 in this order: position x, y, and z (m); velocity x, y, and z (m/s); body rates p, q, and r (rad/s); and airspeed (m/s).

interfaces.name: tracking_state
interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: Log complete-run Timeseries named flight_state, tracking_state, and actuator_state. tracking_state has width 7 in this order: reference position x, y, and z (m); tracking error x, y, and z (m); and active waypoint index (unitless).

interfaces.name: actuator_state
interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: Log complete-run Timeseries named flight_state, tracking_state, and actuator_state. actuator_state has width 8 in this order: left-aileron, right-aileron, left-elevator, right-elevator, rudder, and horizontal-tail-trim deflection (rad); followed by left- and right-motor angular speed (rad/s).
